caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a soldier standing upright on an ornate, multi-tiered circular pedestal. The soldier is shown in full uniform, including a buttoned coat, trousers, boots, and a tall brimmed hat with a plume. He holds a long rifle vertically in front of him with both hands, its butt resting at his feet, and a bayonet attached to the barrel. The soldier is facing to the right, viewed in profile, with his head turned slightly to the right and his legs straight. The drawing is in grayscale, rendered with graphite or charcoal, giving the figure and pedestal various shades of gray to indicate depth and texture. The pedestal features several layers of decorative molding. There are a few white marks on the left side of the statue, possibly from erased lines or intentional highlighting. The background is plain and light-colored with no additional objects or scenery. In the bottom right corner, the name “Joseph Rothenberg” is written.
title: Soldier Figure
